	"context"

// Handler handles internal endpoints.
type Handler struct {
	AssignedLessons          AssignedLessonContextGetter
	NextAction               NextActionGetter
	Answers                  repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	Students                 repository.StudentPracticeTaskRepository
	Mastery                  TargetMasteryGetter
	LearningActions          LearningActionContextGetter
	LearningCode             LearningActionCodeContextGetter
	LearnerOverview          LearnerOverviewGetter
	PlanningReadiness        StudentPlanningReadinessGetter
	PlanningSnapshot         PlanningSnapshotGetter
	HybridApplication        HybridApplicationService
	LearningWorkspace        StudentLearningWorkspaceGetter
	LearningPaths            LearningPathReplacer
	LearningPathCompletion   LearningPathCompleter
	LearningPathPlanning     LearningPathPlanningService
	Diagnostics              DiagnosticSnapshotCapturer
	LearningSessions         LearningSessionMetricsApplier
	CourseAssignments        CourseAssigner
	PracticeEvidence         PracticeEvidenceApplier
	PracticeLearningActions  PracticeLearningActionService
	PracticeLearningEvidence PracticeLearningEvidenceApplier
	DiagnosticAssessments    *studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments
	OnboardingDrafts         StudentOnboardingDraftGetter
	OnboardingDraftWrites    StudentOnboardingDraftPutter
	OnboardingFinalization   StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizer
	OnboardingProfiles       StudentOnboardingProfileGetter
	OnboardingTurnApply      StudentOnboardingTurnApplier
	OnboardingTurns          StudentOnboardingTurnGetter
	OnboardingTurnProofs     StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProver
	OnboardingPathAdmissions OnboardingPathAdmissionService
}
type OnboardingPathAdmissionService interface {
	Reserve(context.Context, string, string, domain.OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error)
	Renew(context.Context, string, string, string, string, int64) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error)
	Materialize(context.Context, string, string, string, domain.OnboardingPathMaterialization) (domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult, bool, error)
	Abort(context.Context, string, string, string, domain.OnboardingPathAbort) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error)
}

type TargetMasteryGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error)
}

type LearningActionContextGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, learningActionID string) (domain.LearningActionContext, error)
}

type LearningActionCodeContextGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, learningActionID string) (domain.LearningActionCodeContext, error)
}

type LearnerOverviewGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.LearnerOverview, error)
}

type StudentPlanningReadinessGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error)
}

type StudentLearningWorkspaceGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspace, error)
}

type LearningPathReplacer interface {
	Handle(context.Context, studentuc.ReplaceLearningPathInput) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
}

type LearningPathCompleter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, studentuc.CompleteLearningPathInput) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
}

type LearningPathPlanningService interface {
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error)
	Replan(context.Context, studentuc.LearningPathReplanInput) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error)
	CompleteNoGap(context.Context, studentuc.LearningPathNoGapInput) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error)
}

type DiagnosticSnapshotCapturer interface {
	Handle(context.Context, studentuc.CaptureDiagnosticInput) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error)
}

type LearningSessionMetricsApplier interface {
	ApplyMetrics(context.Context, string, string, int64, studentuc.LearningSessionMetrics) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
}

type CourseAssigner interface {
	Handle(context.Context, studentuc.AssignCourseInput) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, bool, error)
}

type PracticeEvidenceApplier interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, string, domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle) (domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt, error)
}

type PracticeLearningActionService interface {
	Reserve(context.Context, domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error)
	Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error)
	Open(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error)
	Cancel(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error)
}

type PracticeLearningEvidenceApplier interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, string, string, domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2) (domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2, error)
}

// NewHandler creates a new internal handler.
func NewHandler(
	answers repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository,
	students repository.StudentPracticeTaskRepository,
	mastery TargetMasteryGetter,
	learningActions LearningActionContextGetter,
	learnerOverview ...LearnerOverviewGetter,
) *Handler {
	handler := &Handler{
		Answers:         answers,
		Students:        students,
		Mastery:         mastery,
		LearningActions: learningActions,
	}
	if len(learnerOverview) > 0 {
		handler.LearnerOverview = learnerOverview[0]
	}
	return handler
}

func (h *Handler) AssignCourse(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.CourseAssignments == nil {
		http.Error(w, "Course assignments are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		PlanningRequestID string `json:"planning_request_id"`
		AssignedBy        string `json:"assigned_by"`
	}
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	_, _, err := h.CourseAssignments.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.AssignCourseInput{
		StudentID: chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), CourseID: chi.URLParam(r, "courseID"),
		PlanningRequestID: request.PlanningRequestID, AssignedBy: request.AssignedBy,
		IdempotencyKey: r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"),
	})
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid Course assignment", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			http.Error(w, "Course assignment conflict", http.StatusConflict)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "Course assignment failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// ApplyPracticeEvidence accepts only the bounded public result produced by
// Practice. Validator diagnostics and hidden evaluation assets are never part
// of this Student-owned contract.
func (h *Handler) ApplyPracticeEvidence(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PracticeEvidence == nil {
		http.Error(w, "practice evidence is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	receipt, err := h.PracticeEvidence.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), request)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrEvidenceContract), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid practice evidence", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			http.Error(w, "practice evidence conflict", http.StatusConflict)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "practice evidence ingest failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(receipt)
}

func (h *Handler) ReplaceLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningPaths == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning path is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64                     `json:"expected_onboarding_version"`
		ExpectedDirectionCode     string                    `json:"expected_direction_code"`
		PlanningRequestID         string                    `json:"planning_request_id"`
		CourseID                  string                    `json:"course_id"`
		GoalCode                  string                    `json:"goal_code"`
		CurriculumRevision        string                    `json:"curriculum_revision"`
		CourseFingerprint         string                    `json:"course_fingerprint"`
		PlannerPolicyVersion      string                    `json:"planner_policy_version"`
		ReasonCode                string                    `json:"reason_code"`
		ReasonSummary             string                    `json:"reason_summary"`
		ExpectedVersion           int64                     `json:"expected_version"`
		Items                     []domain.LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if request.CurriculumRevision != "" && request.CourseFingerprint != "" &&
		request.CurriculumRevision != request.CourseFingerprint {
		http.Error(w, "conflicting course fingerprint", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if (request.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 0 || request.ExpectedDirectionCode != "") &&
		(request.ExpectedOnboardingVersion < 1 || strings.TrimSpace(request.ExpectedDirectionCode) == "" || request.ExpectedVersion != 0 || request.PlanningRequestID == "") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid diagnostic context fence", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if request.CurriculumRevision == "" {
		request.CurriculumRevision = request.CourseFingerprint
	}
	idempotencyKey := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	if idempotencyKey == "" {
		idempotencyKey = request.PlanningRequestID
	}
	result, err := h.LearningPaths.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.ReplaceLearningPathInput{
		ExpectedOnboardingVersion: request.ExpectedOnboardingVersion, ExpectedDirectionCode: request.ExpectedDirectionCode,
		StudentID: chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), PlanningRequestID: request.PlanningRequestID,
		IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, CourseID: request.CourseID, GoalCode: request.GoalCode,
		CurriculumRevision: request.CurriculumRevision, ReasonCode: request.ReasonCode,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: request.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonSummary:        request.ReasonSummary, ExpectedVersion: request.ExpectedVersion, Items: request.Items,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

func (h *Handler) CompleteLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningPathCompletion == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning path completion is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		GoalCode             string `json:"goal_code"`
		CourseFingerprint    string `json:"course_fingerprint"`
		PlannerPolicyVersion string `json:"planner_policy_version"`
		ReasonCode           string `json:"reason_code"`
		ReasonSummary        string `json:"reason_summary"`
		ExpectedVersion      int64  `json:"expected_version"`
	}
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningPathCompletion.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.CompleteLearningPathInput{
		StudentID: chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), GoalCode: request.GoalCode,
		CourseFingerprint: request.CourseFingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: request.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonCode: request.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: request.ReasonSummary,
		ExpectedVersion: request.ExpectedVersion,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

	if h.Diagnostics == nil {
		http.Error(w, "diagnostics are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return

		StudentID: chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), AssessmentID: request.AssessmentID,

	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

func (h *Handler) ApplyLearningSessionMetrics(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningSessions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning sessions are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		ExpectedVersion          int64  `json:"expected_version"`
		AnalyticsSessionID       string `json:"analytics_session_id"`
		ActiveLearningSeconds    int    `json:"active_learning_seconds"`
		LessonCount              int    `json:"lesson_count"`
		TaskCount                int    `json:"task_count"`
		QuestionCount            int    `json:"question_count"`
		SelectedExplanationCount int    `json:"selected_explanation_count"`
		CodeRunCount             int    `json:"code_run_count"`
		FailureCount             int    `json:"failure_count"`
		PassedTestCount          int    `json:"passed_test_count"`
		HintCount                int    `json:"hint_count"`
		TeacherInterventionCount int    `json:"teacher_intervention_count"`
		StuckSignalCount         int    `json:"stuck_signal_count"`
	}
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningSessions.ApplyMetrics(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "sessionID"), request.ExpectedVersion, studentuc.LearningSessionMetrics{
		AnalyticsSessionID: request.AnalyticsSessionID, ActiveLearningSeconds: request.ActiveLearningSeconds,
		LessonCount: request.LessonCount, TaskCount: request.TaskCount, QuestionCount: request.QuestionCount,
		SelectedExplanationCount: request.SelectedExplanationCount, CodeRunCount: request.CodeRunCount,
		FailureCount: request.FailureCount, PassedTestCount: request.PassedTestCount,
		HintCount: request.HintCount, TeacherInterventionCount: request.TeacherInterventionCount,
		StuckSignalCount: request.StuckSignalCount,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

func (h *Handler) GetLearningSession(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningSessions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning sessions are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return

	result, err := h.LearningSessions.Get(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "sessionID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

// GetLearningActionCodeContext returns a bounded text-only workspace snapshot
// without answer, Sandbox, secret, binary, or validator-owned data.
func (h *Handler) GetLearningActionCodeContext(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningCode == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning action code context is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningCode.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "learningActionID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

func decodeInternalJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 512<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("invalid trailing request data")
	}
	return nil
}

func writeInternalJourneyError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDiagnosticContextStale):
		http.Error(w, "diagnostic_context_stale", http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, "invalid learning journey request", http.StatusBadRequest)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		http.Error(w, "learning journey version conflict", http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, "learning journey not found", http.StatusNotFound)
	default:
		http.Error(w, "learning journey operation failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}

// GetLearnerOverview returns a bounded Student-owned projection for general teacher dialogs.
func (h *Handler) GetLearnerOverview(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearnerOverview == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learner overview is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearnerOverview.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"))
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid learner overview query", http.StatusBadRequest)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "learner overview query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

// GetStudentPlanningReadiness returns the strict, bounded planning input. It
// intentionally does not reuse the broader learner-overview response.
func (h *Handler) GetStudentPlanningReadiness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PlanningReadiness == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student planning readiness is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.PlanningReadiness.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"))
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, "invalid planning readiness query", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, "planning readiness query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

type progressItemResponse struct {
	TaskID         string `json:"task_id"`
	HasPassed      bool   `json:"has_passed"`
	HasUnderReview bool   `json:"has_under_review"`
	LatestStatus   int    `json:"latest_status"`
	LatestAnswerID string `json:"latest_answer_id,omitempty"`
}

type usageCountResponse struct {
	PracticeTaskID          string `json:"practice_task_id,omitempty"`
	PracticeTaskPartID      string `json:"practice_task_part_id,omitempty"`
	PracticeTaskMilestoneID string `json:"practice_task_milestone_id,omitempty"`
	StudentUsageCount       int    `json:"student_usage_count"`
}

type targetMasteryQueryRequest struct {
	Targets []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
}

type targetMasteryResponse struct {
	Target                  domain.LearningTargetRef  `json:"target"`
	State                   domain.TargetMasteryState `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore            float64                   `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence              float64                   `json:"confidence"`
	IndependentSuccessCount int                       `json:"independent_success_count"`
	AssistedSuccessCount    int                       `json:"assisted_success_count"`
	FailureCount            int                       `json:"failure_count"`
	EvidenceCount           int                       `json:"evidence_count"`
	LastSeenAt              *time.Time                `json:"last_seen_at,omitempty"`
	LastPracticedAt         *time.Time                `json:"last_practiced_at,omitempty"`
	LastFailedAt            *time.Time                `json:"last_failed_at,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion           string                    `json:"policy_version"`
}

// QueryStudentTargetMastery returns bounded relevant mastery without exposing raw evidence.
func (h *Handler) QueryStudentTargetMastery(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.Mastery == nil {
		http.Error(w, "mastery projection is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request targetMasteryQueryRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 128<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	items, err := h.Mastery.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), request.Targets)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, "invalid mastery query", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, "mastery query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	response := make([]targetMasteryResponse, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		var lastSeenAt *time.Time
		if !item.LastSeenAt.IsZero() {
			value := item.LastSeenAt.UTC()
			lastSeenAt = &value
		}
		response = append(response, targetMasteryResponse{
			Target:                  item.Target,
			State:                   item.State,
			MasteryScore:            item.MasteryScore,
			Confidence:              item.Confidence,
			IndependentSuccessCount: item.IndependentSuccessCount,
			AssistedSuccessCount:    item.AssistedSuccessCount,
			FailureCount:            item.FailureCount,
			EvidenceCount:           item.EvidenceCount,
			LastSeenAt:              lastSeenAt,
			LastPracticedAt:         item.LastPracticedAt,
			LastFailedAt:            item.LastFailedAt,
			PolicyVersion:           item.PolicyVersion,
		})
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"items": response})
}

// GetLearningActionContext returns a safe action snapshot without objective outcome.
func (h *Handler) GetLearningActionContext(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningActions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning action context is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningActions.Handle(
		r.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"),
		chi.URLParam(r, "learningActionID"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid learning action context query", http.StatusBadRequest)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "learning action not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "learning action context query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}

// GetAnswerStatus returns answer status.
func (h *Handler) GetAnswerStatus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	answerID := chi.URLParam(r, "answerID")
	answer, err := h.Answers.GetByID(r.Context(), answerID)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]int{"status": answer.Status})
}

// GetTaskProgress returns aggregated progress for selected tasks and one user.
func (h *Handler) GetTaskProgress(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("user_id"))
	if userID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "user_id is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	taskIDs := splitCSV(r.URL.Query().Get("task_ids"))
	if len(taskIDs) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "task_ids is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	progressMap, err := h.Answers.GetProgressByTaskIDs(r.Context(), userID, taskIDs)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	items := make([]progressItemResponse, 0, len(progressMap))
	for _, taskID := range taskIDs {
		progress, ok := progressMap[taskID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		items = append(items, progressItemResponse{
			TaskID:         progress.TaskID,
			HasPassed:      progress.HasPassed,
			HasUnderReview: progress.HasUnderReview,
			LatestStatus:   progress.LatestStatus,
			LatestAnswerID: progress.LatestAnswerID,
		})
	}

	sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
		return items[i].TaskID < items[j].TaskID
	})

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"items": items,
	})
}

func (h *Handler) GetPracticeTaskUsage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.Students == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student repository is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	practiceTaskID := chi.URLParam(r, "id")
	count, err := h.Students.CountStudentPracticeTasksByPracticeTaskID(r.Context(), practiceTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(usageCountResponse{
		PracticeTaskID:    practiceTaskID,
		StudentUsageCount: count,
	})
}

		http.Error(w, "student repository is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)

	})
}

func splitCSV(raw string) []string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return nil
	}
	parts := strings.Split(raw, ",")
	result := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(parts))
	for _, part := range parts {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(part)
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result
}
